name: 037.2 — segments and grids, and the anchor bridge both ways
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 037.2: hafen.map.segment()/segments()/grid(id) open the recorded map database, a Segment and a Grid are entities, and the anchor bridge closes both ways — the player's live grid id resolves INTO the database and names the same tile the live terrain does, while marker:anchor() converts a marker's client-local segment position OUT of it into the {gridId, x, y} that may be saved or shared. Stores one anchor of its own (account scope) so the relog check can prove it still resolves.
